scenarios.what: two peers, no loss: every block delivered in order, paced, with control sent ahead
peer 2 stops consuming and reporting: its window closes, its queue drops its own, the others are untouched, and it recovers with fresh audio only
media saturates the pacer and the aggregate cap: control still goes first in its pump, and media keeps its share
advancing the epoch drops what was queued, a send under the old epoch is refused, a late receiver rejects the new epoch and is rejected in turn
a peer whose path cannot carry a block is refused or fenced without fragmenting and without disturbing the others; so are an over-budget peer, a LAN address and an undeclared address family
a simulated link-down ages queued audio out instead of replaying it; a peer keeps its identity across an address change and the old path's reports are refused
a seeded relay drops and reorders peer 1's datagrams on the way to its receiver; the replay window and the reports cope and the clean peer is unaffected
